description: This is a PHP source file that defines the class Upgrade11 within the Opencart install upgrade module. The class contains an 'index' method responsible for performing database schema updates, data migrations, field and table removals, and other upgrade-related tasks for version 11 of the software.

classes.name: Upgrade11
classes.description: Represents an upgrade controller for version 11, extending the core Controller class and containing the main 'index' method for executing database migrations and schema updates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Performs database updates, schema modifications, data migrations, and cleanup tasks necessary for migrating to version 11 of the system.
